result.SEND_BACK: {count, plural, one {It goes} other {They go}} back to the owner for editing. The owner and the Head are told. After the next submit, approval starts again at the Head.
result.REJECT: {count, plural, one {It is} other {They are}} refused for good and can no longer change. The owner and the Head are told. The owner can still copy it as a new order.
result.CANCEL: {count, plural, one {It stops} other {They stop}} for good and can no longer change.
result.TAKE_BACK: {count, plural, one {It returns} other {They return}} to your drafts with the same number, to be edited and submitted again.
result.SUBMIT_AGAIN: {count, plural, one {It goes} other {They go}} to the Head again with the next revision and the same number. Earlier approvals no longer count.
result.FINISH_ORDER: Buying stops with what was received: Done, short when less than planned. The next step is closing or settlement.
result.MARK_NOT_BOUGHT: Nothing is bought. In settlement any cash given is returned in full.
result.REOPEN_BUYING: {count, plural, one {Its buying is} other {Their buying is}} open again, so more purchases can be recorded.
result.CLOSE_EXACT: {count, plural, one {1 order will be Closed} other {# orders will be Closed}} and can no longer change. The owner, the Head and Finance are told.
result.SEND_TO_SETTLEMENT: {count, plural, one {1 order goes} other {# orders go}} to Finance for settlement. Finance is told.
result.SEND_BACK_FOR_CORRECTION: {count, plural, one {It goes} other {They go}} back to Open, so a wrong record can be corrected; its settlement confirmations are cleared. The owner and the Head are told.
result.CLOSE: {count, plural, one {1 order will be Closed} other {# orders will be Closed}} and can no longer change. If any order is not ready, nothing closes and the orders are named. The owner, the Head and Finance are told.
result.REOPEN: {count, plural, one {It goes} other {They go}} back to Open, so a mistake can be corrected. Settlement confirmations and the overspend acknowledgment are cleared, and Finance settles {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} again. The owner, the Head and Finance are told.
result.ACKNOWLEDGE_OVERSPEND: Finance can then close {count, plural, one {this order} other {these orders}} with the actual total above the plan. Your comment is kept in each order's history, and Finance of the branch is told.
result.MOVE_OWNER: The chosen Manager becomes the owner of {count, plural, one {this order} other {these orders}}. Only orders whose cash count is 0 can move; the move is kept in each order's history.
